evidence_gaps: Fresh-within-two-hours runtime forensics are unavailable; evidence.json explicitly reports MISSING_RUNTIME_FORENSICS.
No realised money-weighted net P&L by strategy version, Git SHA, chain, asset, and notional after every fee, slippage, price-impact, and failed-attempt cost.
No complete opportunity ledger covering eligible trades, abstentions, stale quotes, simulations, rejected submissions, failed executions, open positions, and closed outcomes.
No per-outcome classification separating STRATEGY/MARKET loss from EXECUTION/INFRASTRUCTURE failure with attributable cost.
No EVM chain-specific gas estimates versus actual gas, revert costs, quote-to-inclusion decay, nonce/reconciliation failures, realised slippage, or route-level price impact.

No Solana per-trade priority/base fees, refundable and non-refundable rent treatment, Jupiter quote-to-fill deviation, transaction inclusion/result failures, exit sellability, or realised price impact.
No out-of-sample money-weighted profit factor, largest loss, drawdown, tail loss, capital duration, or confidence interval by strategy and chain.
No evidence that the learned-route history includes all proven losing outcomes without survivorship or look-ahead bias.
No independently settled SHADOW counterfactual outcomes; current quote-simulated net values are derived from decision-time expected edge.

Before any promotion: require fresh runtime evidence, immutable strategy provenance, complete cost reconciliation, at least the policy-required independent SHADOW windows and trades, positive money-weighted net P&L, profit factor at or above the configured floor, adequate opportunity/failure coverage, sellability and liquidity evidence, and no unresolved execution-safety defect. CANARY and LIVE additionally require their documented human approvals and real-trade evidence.

proposals.downside_risk: More routes will remain dormant and sparse routes may take longer to evaluate.

evidence.detail: learn_patterns computes avg_net_base only from proven rows whose net_base is positive, excluding proven losses from the learned route average.
_learned_route_stats imports avg_net_base as historical learned net edge and requires it to be positive.
learned_route_replication uses learned_route_avg_net_bps in eligibility and scoring alongside current quoted edge.

proposals.expected_effect: Reduce false-positive route replication and align ranking with durable money-weighted net expectancy rather than win count or average winner size.
proposals.minimum_observation: At least 30 closed out-of-sample opportunities per EVM chain, spanning at least 7 days and multiple fee/volatility regimes, with complete inclusion of winners, losers, skips, and failed executions.
proposals.rationale: A positive-only historical mean is selection-biased and can make a route with large or frequent losses appear attractive. Route evidence should include every proven closed outcome, money-weighted by deployed notional, with gas, builder fees, slippage, price impact, failed-execution costs, and platform fees attributed by EVM chain.
proposals.shadow_test: Replay unchanged eligible EVM observations out of sample using both the current positive-only feature and an all-proven-outcomes money-weighted feature. Charge contemporaneous gas, builder/platform fees, slippage, price impact, revert costs, and execution failures. Stop and reject the replacement if it does not improve net P&L or profit factor, if its largest loss worsens materially, or if fewer than 30 independently closed simulated opportunities exist per evaluated chain.

proposals.downside_risk: Counterfactual fills remain imperfect and may understate adverse selection unless quote timestamps, failure costs, and liquidity constraints are captured rigorously.

evidence.detail: evaluate_envelopes calculates quote_simulated_net_base as notional multiplied by the signal's decision-time expected_net_edge_bps; promotion_evidence is correctly forced to zero.
scorecard aggregates quote-simulated results but does not independently settle later executable counterfactual outcomes or execution-failure causes.
Evaluation storage supports gross loss, fees, slippage, net profit, largest loss, and execution_failures, providing a suitable research-only destination for richer outcome attribution.

proposals.expected_effect: Produce falsifiable out-of-sample evidence, expose quote-to-outcome decay, and prevent expected edge from being mistaken for earned P&L.
proposals.minimum_observation: At least 100 eligible settled signals overall, at least 30 per represented chain family, at least 7 days, and explicit accounting for every eligible signal including skips and failures.
proposals.rationale: Decision-time quote economics validate entry gating but cannot demonstrate realised expectancy. A later, immutable counterfactual outcome should re-quote the intended exit and record all costs, while separately labelling adverse market movement and technical execution failure.
proposals.shadow_test: For every eligible signal, freeze decision inputs and settle one or more predefined horizons using executable-size quotes. Record gross return, entry and exit fees, gas or Solana priority fees, platform fees, slippage, price impact, failed-attempt cost, and net return. Label valid completed paths with adverse net return as STRATEGY_MARKET_LOSS; label RPC, simulation, submission, inclusion, reconciliation, stale-quote, and exit failures as EXECUTION_INFRASTRUCTURE_FAILURE. Stop if outcome coverage falls below 95%, timestamps cannot prevent look-ahead, or cost fields are incomplete.

proposals.downside_risk: Additional quotes may increase API usage and observations may expire before settlement; caching and material-change gates are needed without weakening freshness checks.

evidence.detail: load_solana_market_features intentionally sets gross edge, fees, slippage, price impact, liquidity, and sellability to zero and marks needs_quote_feature_adapter.
The common eligibility gate requires positive net edge, sufficient liquidity and sellability, and fresh quotes, so current Solana Strategy Lab observations correctly fail closed.
Solana has a separate leader-copying implementation and therefore requires Solana-specific quote, priority-fee, rent, price-impact, and exit-liquidity economics rather than EVM gas assumptions.

proposals.expected_effect: Enable honest Solana opportunity measurement while preserving abstention whenever executable edge or exit capacity is unknown.
proposals.minimum_observation: At least 100 settled Solana signals over at least 7 days, including at least 30 during elevated congestion or volatility, with complete quote-age, route, fee, price-impact, sellability, and failure attribution.
proposals.rationale: Solana cannot be evaluated by the common Strategy Lab until contemporaneous entry and exit quote economics exist. The adapter should remain SHADOW-only and include Jupiter route price impact, slippage, priority/base fees, refundable versus non-refundable rent, sellability, and execution-failure reserves.
proposals.shadow_test: Capture executable entry and immediate exit quotes at the intended size for naturally observed leader signals, then settle fixed-horizon counterfactual exits. Net all priority/base fees, non-refundable rent, platform fees, slippage, price impact, and failed-attempt costs. Reject the hypothesis if money-weighted net P&L is non-positive, profit factor is below 1.10, sellable outcome coverage is below 95%, or any missing quote is treated as positive edge.

rejected_ideas.idea: Promote any strategy from the current evidence package.
rejected_ideas.reason: Runtime forensics are missing and the available architecture/quote logic cannot establish realised profitability, CANARY readiness, or LIVE readiness.

rejected_ideas.idea: Increase trade frequency or relax liquidity, sellability, simulation, quote-age, price-impact, or positive-edge gates to obtain a larger sample.
rejected_ideas.reason: Forced participation can convert missing edge into avoidable losses and would weaken safety controls.

rejected_ideas.idea: Rank leaders or routes primarily by win rate or positive-trade ratio.
rejected_ideas.reason: Win count ignores money-weighted loss severity and total execution costs; a high-win strategy can have negative net expectancy.

rejected_ideas.idea: Apply identical cost thresholds and exit parameters across Solana and EVM.
rejected_ideas.reason: Solana priority fees, rent/account handling, Jupiter routing, and slot-sensitive liquidity differ materially from EVM gas, nonce, revert, and inclusion economics.

summary: Architecture-only review completed. The repository has fail-closed execution gates and separates SHADOW research from LIVE promotion, but two research-accounting weaknesses could overstate expected edge: learned-route averages exclude proven losing outcomes, and SHADOW quote results reuse decision-time expected edge rather than independently measured future outcomes. Solana is currently fail-closed because its Strategy Lab adapter lacks contemporaneous executable quote economics. No profitability, CANARY-readiness, or LIVE-readiness conclusion is possible without fresh realised, chain-attributed runtime forensics. Future analysis must classify negative outcomes as STRATEGY/MARKET loss when valid execution completed but the market outcome was adverse, versus EXECUTION/INFRASTRUCTURE failure when quote expiry, RPC, simulation, submission, inclusion, reconciliation, or exit failure caused the loss or prevented execution.
